Eleva websites are built using a proprietary page builder and do not have a supported method for exporting a website for use on another platform.

This article explains what is and is not supported when customers attempt to export Eleva websites.

Can Eleva Websites Be Exported?

No.
Eleva does not support exporting websites in a way that allows them to be managed or edited outside the Eleva platform.

There is no supported 1:1 website export.

About Copying Website HTML

From a technical standpoint, the rendered HTML output of a website can be copied and hosted elsewhere.

When this is done with a Eleva website:

  • The copied page is no longer managed by Eleva

  • The page is not editable through the Eleva builder

  • Eleva does not provide support for externally hosted copies

  • Continued functionality depends on the original Eleva location and assets remaining active

This is not considered a supported website export.

How to Copy Page HTML (Unsupported)

If you choose to copy the rendered HTML of a Eleva page, this can be done directly from a web browser.

Example method:

  1. Open the published page in your browser

  2. Right-click anywhere on the page and select View Page Source (or similar)

  3. Copy the HTML content and save it as an .html file

This method copies the rendered output of the page only.

Eleva does not provide tools, guidance, or support for copying, hosting, or maintaining externally hosted HTML files.

What Copied HTML May Be Used For

Copied HTML may be used for:

  • Referencing or recovering content

  • Manually rebuilding the website on another platform

  • Archival or record-keeping purposes
